content: Fiye 40:1-23 Yosepdi Meyat Lihine Meebii Yeeniŋguk.
Nemek i mintaguk sigiineŋ mapme diniŋ wain ime tutumba diniŋ talitimeŋ eŋ belet heheŋ diniŋ talk timeŋ adi kwanaihik tubukadakagumuk.
Unduŋ tubune biyagoŋ hinek Felo adi kwanai meŋiyat wain kadoko eŋ belet heheŋ diniŋ kadoko aditok kwihitayemguk.
Unduŋ doktiŋa yobune ne’walaŋ mik me heki diniŋ talitimeŋ’walaŋ yolineŋ yot fafaŋeniŋ ginaŋ yapmegiŋ. Yosep maaŋ yot uŋgoŋ deitouluguk.
Ala yot fafaŋeniŋ diniŋ kadokodi Yosep adi yabudokodok niŋdapmaguk. Kaŋ adi nai muniniŋ yot fafaŋeniŋ ginaŋ hatigumuk.

Tiŋa timiŋ kubugoŋ niŋ foloŋ lihine wanaŋ tugumuk. Ala lihine molomoloom tugumuk eŋ lihine u mebinit tugumuk. Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, Isipniŋ mapme’walaŋ wain ime kodoko eŋ belet heheŋ diniŋ kadoko adi unduŋ tugumuk.
Ala kwet heleune Yosepdi adi’walaŋ yohineŋ looŋ bulaaniŋgoŋ namandap ila diweeune yabuguk.
Yabuŋa yeninadiguk, “Hidi kamiŋ deetiŋa bulaaniŋgoŋ namandap ikaamuk?”
Yobune niŋgumuk, “Indi lihine tumut, tiŋa me neediyeŋ mebi ninimbek yoŋa lohiyamut.” Kaŋ Yosepdi yoguk, “Lihine diniŋ mebi adi Bepaŋdi hogok nadilak iŋgoŋ fiit yobune nadiwit.”
Kaŋ wain ime kadokodi lihine tuguk wondiniŋ mede kahat timiŋa yoguk, “Nu ye indiŋ kaŋat. Habaatne foloŋ wain mebi niŋ mintaune kaŋat.
Tiŋa taŋeeniŋ lufomkulitniŋ mintalune wowoŋ niŋ maaŋ youkuk. Tiŋa undugoŋ folooŋ mintaaŋ gimindaŋak.
Kaŋ nu yadi Felo’walaŋ ime utnaŋ kohoonedi hooneeŋ yale mindipmuŋ gimihi moŋgola kahileene imeeŋiŋ ime utnaŋ ginaŋ foune tiŋa Felo kohoŋ ginaŋ kamewene hooneŋak.”
Kaŋ Yosepdibo niŋguk, “Woondiniŋ mebi indiŋ. Taŋeeniŋ lufomkulitniŋ woondi melenai lufomkulitniŋ wondok tuwolit.
Ala melenai lufomkulitniŋ tubune dapmaune Felodi ganindapmaaŋ kwanaige ginaŋ kotigoŋ gapmewaak, kaŋ du koom wain kadoko hatiŋa Felo wain ime miluguŋ undugoŋ kotigoŋ tibaaŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa nadifo foloŋ hatiŋale nu kadaa maaŋ nadinamuŋa Felo nimbaaŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa nehitubulodaune, yot i bikabuŋa fooŋ waat.
Naadilaŋ be! Nu Kanaaŋ kwetneniŋ kubo nanagikiŋ eŋ iŋoŋ maaŋ undugoŋ nemek kadakaniŋ nemu tibene hogok hinehinek yot fafaŋeniŋ ginaŋ napmegiŋ.”

Unduŋ tubune belet heheŋ diniŋ talitimeŋ adi Yosepdi lihine diniŋ mebi momooŋ hinek yodakaleŋak unduŋ kaŋ indiŋ niŋguk, “Nu maaŋ lihine indiŋ tiŋat. Nu boondiboondi lufomkulitniŋ belet nit mebine foloŋ udieŋat.
Kaŋ bondibondi wohiŋ ilaŋak wondiniŋ maaneŋ Felo’walaŋ belet kobaaŋ mebimebi ituune bagi hekidi buŋa naŋit.”
Unduŋ yobune Yosepdi indiŋ tubuudaneeŋ niŋguk, “Wondiniŋ mebi indiŋ. Bondibondi lufomkulitniŋ adi melenai lufomkulitniŋdok tuwolit iŋgoŋ.
Ala melenai lufomkulitniŋ dapmaune Felodi yobune bem fuloŋ gehitehikapmaneeŋ kaŋ bagi hekidi folooge goom nadapmaneeŋ.”

Ala agaŋ melenai lufomkulitniŋ dapmaune Felo mintamintaŋiŋ nai foloŋ kwanai meŋiyedok hinaŋ muni tiyemguk. Unduŋ tiŋa kwanai meŋiye namandahik foloŋ wain kadoko taali timeŋ eŋ belet heheŋ taali timeŋ adi’walaŋ mede yodapmaguk.
Tiŋa wain kadoko diniŋ talitimeŋ adi ime utnaŋiŋ kotigoŋ mimindok niŋguk. Kwanaiŋiŋ komii uŋaakoŋ hinek kotigoŋ miŋguk.
Eŋ belet heheŋ diniŋ talitimeŋ adi Yosepdi yeniŋguk undugoŋ hinek tehikapmagiŋ.
Kaŋ wain kadoko diniŋ talitimeŋ adi Yosepdok mu nadisuuguk. Adi yadi kaule tiŋa hatiguk.
